hooks.prompt:
You check whether Claude kept ReconOS documents in sync before stopping. Hook input: $ARGUMENTS

If stop_hook_active is true, respond {"ok": true}.
Read last_assistant_message and check two cases.
Case A: the message reports that the user agreed on a new term, a word replacement, or a wording convention for documents, and the message lacks a line like 'Thuật ngữ mới: X → Y, đã cập nhật glossary'.
Case B: the message reports a new or changed project decision (business rule, schema, status, endpoint, contract, tool module, module, role, config, library, infrastructure, deferred work), and the message lacks a line starting with 'Đồng bộ tài liệu:'.
Answers to general questions, explanations, proposals awaiting the user's choice, and pure code edits that change no decision are NOT decisions.
If case A or B holds, respond {"ok": false, "reason": "..."}. Write the reason in Vietnamese: name the decision, tell Claude to update the documents per .claude/rules/doc-sync.md (case A: add the row to bảng Từ không dùng in docs/appendix/glossary.md and grep the old word in docs/, .claude/rules/ and every CLAUDE.md to fix all occurrences), then end with the missing line.
Otherwise respond {"ok": true}. Respond with JSON only.
